purpose: 12-question A-F readiness diagnostic for the SEC US Treasury clearing mandate (cash Dec 31 2026 / repo Jun 30 2027). Grades scope, access, margin capacity, capital, ops/docs, and liquidity; routes to the right treasury-clearing chain and emits a remediation checklist.
